title: Peterson offered to show Fitts a UFO if she stopped her research

tellings.quote: John Peterson promised to show uh Katherine Austin Fitz a UFO if she would stop engaging in her research.

plain: In 1998, a man named John Peterson, connected to a place called the Arlington Institute, is said to have promised to show a researcher named Katherine Austin Fitz a UFO if she would stop her research. Michels tells this himself, in an episode with the guest Richard Dolan, as something passed on from people involved, and he also names a woman called Linda Thompson in connection with it. If true, it would mean someone was offering a look at a UFO as a bargain to make an inquiry go away.
